name: Penalty Report 1
definition: Specifies the details of the penalties report.

ReportIdentification.name: Report Identification
ReportIdentification.definition: Reference common to all pages of a report.

PenaltyListType.name: Penalty List Type
PenaltyListType.definition: Specifies whether the penalty list reported contains new computed penalties or updated/removed penalties.

UpdateType.name: Update Type
UpdateType.definition: Indicates whether the statement is complete or contains changes only.

ActivityIndicator.name: Activity Indicator
ActivityIndicator.definition: Indicates whether there is activity or information update reported in the report.

ReportDatePeriodPresenceRule.definition: At least on occurence of ReportDate or ReportPeriod must be present.
